era: TV Tropes 2019 (Arquivo captures Jan, Jul, Sep and Dec 2019): dark slate header with the TV Tropes logo, Tropes / Media / Browse / Indexes / Forums / Videos nav, Join / Login and search, blue sub-bar (SugarWiki, DarthWiki, YMMV, WMG, Trivia), white content column with a grey right sidebar, and a slate footer with Subscribe + social icons and TVTropes / Community / Tropes HQ columns. The 2019 site offered a night-vision (dark) mode.
